notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-1.86.0.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Nhom moi "4b. Vat can": chon phan tu trong view (Filled Region, Room, Floor, family, tuong...) hoac ve vung can hinh chu nhat 2 diem; bang liet ke loai + dien tich; bo tung cai / bo het. Vat can khai bao theo phong. - Co vat can -> diem xa nhat va duong thoat nan tinh theo LUOI O VUONG tranh vat can (o <= 0,5 m, co dem nua be rong dai de dai 1,2 m lot qua): lan truyen tu moi loi ra, o xa nhat = cho lam viec xa nhat; duong di keo thang thanh it doan nhat, chi di thang va re vuong goc, noi vao tam cua cung vuong goc.
